paper.title_en: An asymptotically conical regular black hole in four-dimensional nonpolynomial quasitopological gravity
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we construct an asymptotically conical regular black hole in four-dimensional nonpolynomial quasitopological gravity. Starting from a linear choice of the reduced function, which yields an asymptotically conical Schwarzschild-like solution, we introduce a nonlinear deformation that preserves the leading asymptotic cone while producing an exact black hole solution with a de Sitter core and finite curvature invariants. We further establish the corresponding black hole thermodynamics for both solutions within the Hamiltonian and Wald frameworks. The entropy contains rational and logarithmic terms in the regular model, and both solutions satisfy the first law of black hole thermodynamics.

decision.title_zh: 四维非多项式拟拓扑引力中的一个渐近锥性正则黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们在四维非多项式拟拓扑引力中构造了一个渐近锥性正则黑洞。我们从约化函数的线性选择出发，该选择给出一个渐近锥性的类施瓦茨席尔德解；随后我们引入一个非线性形变，该形变在保持主导渐近锥的同时，产生一个具有德西特核心和有限曲率不变量的精确黑洞解。我们进一步在哈密顿框架和Wald框架内为这两个解建立相应的黑洞热力学。在正则模型中，熵包含有理项和对数项，且两个解均满足黑洞热力学第一定律。
